finding: Agents repeatedly use PowerShell text IO or range-slicing patterns despite repository instructions requiring Node.js UTF-8 helpers for Markdown, JSON, and text planning files.
expectedBehavior: First-layer ATM skills and playbooks should expose copy-paste-safe Node.js UTF-8 read/compare snippets and warn against PowerShell Get-Content/Set-Content/Out-File/range slicing for document work.
evidenceOrRepro: During ATM-GOV-0186/ATM-GOV-0194 dogfood, the operator used PowerShell content commands before noticing the Windows Text Document IO Rule in atm-dispatch/atm-plan-authoring. Closed by the focused Windows text IO regression: the source template and all six installed atm-dispatch projections expose a copy-paste-safe Node.js UTF-8 read example and prohibit evaluated Node or PowerShell content IO in that example.
followUp: Closed on 2026-09-06 after template/projection parity, captain-dispatch protocol, focused regression, typecheck, encoding guard, and diff checks passed. Reopen only if a supported first-layer entry loses the safe example or diverges from the source template.
